full_text: NOTICE OF STATUTORY EXHAUSTION AND CDSS DEFAULT. TO: California Department of Social Services State Hearings Division. CASE NAME: HERNANDEZ, NICOLAS. CASE NUMBER: SHN-105273296. DATE OF FILING: March 15, 2026. STATUTORY DUE DATE: June 15, 2026. I, Nicolas Hernandez, submit this formal Notice of Statutory Exhaustion and CDSS Default... federal regulation 42 CFR 431.244 and MPP 22-060... L.A. Care's persistent non-action... 28-day emergency supply of Diazepam issued on June 8, 2026, running out on July 6, 2026.
summary: Page 1 of the formal Notice of Statutory Exhaustion and CDSS Default filed in Case SHN-105273296. The document details the state's 90-day deadline default and explains the life-critical benzodiazepine taper emergency. It notes that the patient's provider had to issue a final 28-day emergency lifeline of Diazepam on June 8, 2026, which runs out on July 6, 2026, due to L.A. Care's persistent withholding of reimbursement.
